rec.name: Cost Transparency Price Breakdown (PDP Image)
rec.status: Built — asset corrected (typo fix); reference for reuse

what.text: A product-gallery image on the PDP that explains how the price is made up. The headline is 'Quality has its price' and the subheadline is 'This is how our prices are composed'. Four circular photos each carry a percentage and a label: 45% Development & Production, 25% Personnel, 20% Sales, 10% Profit. Below them is an 'Our promise' paragraph about high-quality materials, durable quality, fair pay and good working conditions. The ticket itself only covers fixing a typo in this image and supplies the corrected file.

why.text: Showing where the money goes makes a higher price feel fair and justified, which reduces price objections. A small profit share (10%) signals honesty, and the promise text adds ethical and quality reassurance. Simple percentages are quick to scan, and the image sits in the gallery where shoppers already look while deciding.

how.text: Design a static infographic card and add it as an extra image in the PDP media gallery (ideally position 2–4). Use a headline and subline, four equal columns (circular image, bold percentage, short label), and a short promise paragraph. Export it at gallery resolution and proofread it, because the ticket was raised for a typo. No Liquid is needed if it is uploaded as a normal product image.

items: Cost categories and percentage values (should sum to 100%)

dependencies.text: No apps are needed if it is used as a standard product image. Per-product breakdowns would need real cost data. The ticket gives no metafield or theme requirements.

items: Gallery interaction / swipe depth to this image
Bounce rate and exit rate on the PDP
Revenue per visitor (to check effect on price sensitivity)

images.caption: Corrected cost-transparency image: 'Qualität hat ihren Preis' with a 45/25/20/10 split and an 'Unser Versprechen' text, shown over a dimmed mobile PDP mockup.
Layout of four circular photos with percentages and labels above a promise paragraph, as a gallery image.
